name: IVI 3D 0.3 nozzle - Tuned
machine_start_gcode:
M82 ;absolute extrusion mode
;Header Start

;FLAVOR:Marlin
;header_type: 3dp,0.3mm
;material_type: [filament_type]
;nozzle_temperature(°C): [nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
;build_plate_temperature(°C): [bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]

;Header End

;G-code for 3dp engraving
;Generated by IVI 3licer
;Start GCode begin
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
G28 ;home
G90 ;absolute positioning
G1 Y-100.0 Z15.0 F2000
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;Wait for Hotend Temperature
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ;Wait for Bed Temperature
G92 E0
G1 Z0.8 F500.0
G1 E7.0 F300 ;re-prime 6.5mm end-of-print retraction + 0.5mm pressure
G92 E0
G1 X8.66 Y-98.94 E8.0 F500.0 ; intro line
G1 X17.25 Y-97.81 E15 F500.0 ; intro line
G92 E0
;Start GCode end
machine_end_gcode:
;End GCode begin
G91 ;relative positioning
G1 E-6.5 F2400 ;fast full retraction to kill ooze pressure
G1 X3 Y3 Z0.4 F6000 ;quick sideways wipe-and-lift to shear strand cleanly
G1 Z10 F3000 ;clear the print
G90 ;absolute positioning
M104 S0 ;extruder heater off
M140 S0 ;heated bed heater off
M106 S0 ;part cooling fan off
G28 ;home cleanly to top
M203 Z500
M82 ;absolute extrusion mode
;End of Gcode
